programme.title: 特工狂花 / Miss Agent
programme.desc: 東南亞最大人口販賣組織頭目巴頌在自己的私人俱樂部設宴，邀請世界各地犯罪集團的頭目參加。雅美成功潛入俱樂部執行任務，為了掩護隊友撤退，美獨自引爆炸彈，與未婚夫方立一起裝死後隱居。三年後方立被綁架，迫雅美再執行任務，為救方立，美誓要將巴頌的犯罪組織一網打盡。

programme.title: 津沽奇譚1：暗城殺機 / Deadly Puppet
programme.desc: 民國時期，津沽城命案接連發生，警局束手無策。一向以"風水破案"的段宇豪和祁威被要求調查此案以戴罪立功，免除之前的懲罰，但在找線索的同時，二人卻被一步步地推向多年前發生的"羅剎鳥連環殺人案"。段宇豪與祁威一同攜手，決心查明真相並要抓住真兇。

programme.title: 臥狼行動 / Brother Wolf
programme.desc: 邊防部隊正在追蹤國內最大毒梟組織旭東商會的一批價值數百萬美元的毒品，卻被劉老三團夥搶走。警方找到在監獄服刑劉的兄弟大飛，說服他幫忙找回毒品。組織老大黃旭東知道貨被搶，便找了國際僱傭軍準備捉人搶貨。邊防部隊，黑幫及僱傭軍將展開一場緊張刺激的追逐角力戰!

programme.title: 鎮魔司：靈源秘術 / Demon Sealer Bureau
programme.desc: 百年前，玉須仙師封印變種異獸於八州。大趙王朝四十年，往生邪教顧念彤煉祭樹妖破壞封印，皇上命封魔局主管唐淩風前往滅妖，而其中需要《魯班全書》中的秘術來擊敗樹妖。而數十年前公輸家為得到魯班全書將唐氏滅門，但唐淩風僥倖逃脫。這次任務揭開唐的身世秘密及唐家的血海深仇.

programme.title: 東北戀哥 / Northeastern Bro
programme.desc: 二十世紀90年代末的哈爾濱，於鐵在替人收債時，對借貸人的女兒金佳麗一見鍾情。鐵雖然是收債人，但他為人講義氣、心地善良及認真對待感情的態度，終於打動了麗。可惜鐵突如其來的頭痛，加上與收債組織的大哥在處事上有分歧，令他們這段感情漸漸步入困境。

programme.title: 少林降魔 / Vanquishing the Demons
programme.desc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世，將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄，少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海，不畏困難，幫助慧海破除心魔，參透少林精神，最終憑藉著少林子弟的力量，破除幻境道，還蒼生太平！

programme.title: 新道師爺 / Demon Catcher
programme.desc: 民國時期，一代奇人關師爺行走江湖，巧遇狐妖鬧事。關師爺與狐妖鬥法，過程中認識了逢賭必輸的葉飛。此事過後，關師爺又巧妙化解了一樁青樓恩怨，為死去的冤者伸冤，卻再次與怪事纏身的葉飛相遇。之後二人攜手與妖怪及邪靈鬥智鬥勇，成功地降魔伏妖。

programme.title: 少俠快跑 / Shao Xia Kuai Pao
programme.desc: 南宋年間，在方圓八百裡之地有少俠與飛雲客棧的夥伴們聯手協助將軍李顯忠展開北伐，收復失地。但他們的努力卻遭到副將邵宏淵的嫉妒和破壞，最後導致北伐失敗。眾人非常氣憤，誓要捉拿邵宏淵，並要協助百姓們安全撤離，等待機會日後東山再起。

programme.title: 滅狼行動 / Wolf Killing Action
programme.desc: 在一次打擊邊境犯罪的行動中，特種兵王週揚、肖克二人參與了邊境黑勢力清剿活動，卻遭遇戰友慘死，此後兩人陷入深深的不安和自責中。及後在一次面對黑勢力的逆襲時，兩人決定再度聯手，共同對抗敵人。一場正義與邪惡的終極對決正式拉開。

programme.title: 功夫宗師霍元甲 / Fearless Kungfu King
programme.desc: 霍元甲年少氣盛，認為武術為重。為了在天津的武館立足，他連續打敗了七家武館，在對戰大刀王五的徒弟幽蘭時，卻遭到朝廷勢力袁庭山的陷害。與此同時，霍負責護送維新首領譚先生回京城。在這次驚心動魄的任務中，他逐漸明白習武的真正意義是為國為民。

programme.title: 漠北追擊 / Dangerous Pursuit
programme.desc: 緝毒精英的閆鵬在追捕毒販赤那時，同事兼好友阿古拉犧牲於毒販手中。之後鵬來到阿古拉家照顧他的家人，卻不料碰上真正的赤那到來，要阿古拉父親帶路，幫他逃離邊境。鵬隨後才知道，先前被他消滅的毒販竟然是赤那的孿生弟弟。他誓要捉拿真正的毒販赤那，把他繩之以法。

programme.title: 修羅新娘 / Love in Blood
programme.desc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜，為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定，甘願飲毒酒假死，豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心，為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女，連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王萱不離不棄，與她共同尋找真相，沒想到牽扯出背後更大的陰謀。

programme.title: 風起洛陽之陰陽界 / Feng Qi Luo Yang
programme.desc: 武週時期，生活在洛陽洛河水兩端但不同出生的兩個少女意外被捲入懸案之中。一位是金吾衛隊長的女兒趙青青，另一位是生於市井底層的女孩小騙子。她們一同遭遇在洛陽城內一連串匪夷所思的離奇案件，二人組成了臨時搭檔，在亂世中維護正義，一起破解懸案。

programme.title: 龍雲鎮怪談 / Tales of Longyun Town
programme.desc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮，相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷，接連出現少女家中被殺。同時，寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士”紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力，決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真兇及解開背後陰謀，守衛龍雲鎮。。

programme.title: 狄仁傑之雷火玄龍 / Dee Renjie Thunder Fire XuanLong
programme.desc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒，木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案，卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺，也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時刻，狄仁傑擊敗雷火玄龍，誓要還原事件真相。

programme.title: 特警本色 / SWAT
programme.desc: 特警大隊狙擊手張遠和觀察手胡兵在一次行動中，意外將人質李翔打傷致癱瘓。張之後離開特警大隊，與李成為搭檔。三年後，張根據一次調查線索潛入一家制毒工廠，卻發現前隊友胡是工廠負責人。與此同時，張剛巧碰上另一販毒團夥前來搶劫毒品，不幸被迫捲入這場激烈的毒戰中。

programme.title: 封神·紂滅 / Fengshen the Fall of King Zhou
programme.desc: 女媧諸神啟動“封神計畫”顛覆商朝統治，安排了九尾妖狐上身妲己前來迷惑紂王。而紂王日漸傾心妲己對她專寵無度，更不服神旨逆天而行，建摘星樓登天問道與神對抗，並受申公豹挑唆殘害忠良，百姓苦不堪言。姜子牙助四方諸侯攻打朝歌，一場橫跨人、神、妖三界的戰爭史詩拉開序幕。

programme.title: 牛魔王之魔王再臨 / Bull Demon King Rise Again
programme.desc: 上古時期，魔族首領蚩尤擾亂天庭，最終被打回原形，天尊把他貶為凡人，及賜給他仁慈的心。數年後，蚩尤體內的魔性被別有用心的人喚醒，他便前往昆侖尋求解封方法。蚩尤途中結識了火焰山公主葉瀟瀟，二人情愫漸生，而蚩尤與瀟瀟幾經考驗，最終逐步揭開圍繞在蚩尤身邊的陰謀。

programme.title: 掃黑英雄 / Intrepid Hero
programme.desc: 明德市郊外發生了一宗拋屍命案，公安局副局長楊棟帶領整個警隊展開深入調查。他們逐步揭開了以企業家林峰為首的頂峰集團涉嫌殺人、放高利貸、及開設賭場等罪行。隨著對掃除黑勢力專案的持續進行，那些無惡不作的犯罪分子與警方的掃黑小隊展開了一場又一場的激烈戰鬥。

programme.title: 大幻術師 / The Great Illusionist
programme.desc: 民國時期，北海市發生連續殺人案，幻術師羅賓協助警員龍聰調查。兩人發現死者大多是隱姓埋名的幻術師，羅賓推測兇手殺人的目的是為了寶藏，卻發現真兇美智子利用暗黑幻術殺人。最後美智子用幻術召喚出玄冰白虎，而羅賓則召喚出火龍與她進行生死搏鬥。

programme.title: 魅影狂花 / Killing Angels
programme.desc: 民國女學生林家英親眼目睹姐姐被軍閥馬世傑迫害致死而卻無能為力，並在隨後趕到的何美梓口中得知姐姐原來是秘密特工隊“魅影”的一員。為替姐姐報仇，英加入魅影特工隊，接受訓練成為一名美豔特工。在一次執行任務中，英漸漸察覺到在魅影背後的神秘面紗。

programme.title: 大幻獸 / Big Eudemon
programme.desc: 長安大理寺捕快郝龍霄神功蓋世，卻為救被妖獸傷害的妹妹，被幻獸妖魔之王鬼車所利用，得奪取各樣法器來助鬼車開啟陣法。原來鬼車的目的是吸聚百姓精血，顛覆人類，以幻獸來控制世界。幸而郝識破鬼車的陰謀，在危急關頭打開了自己真身，與鬼車展開了一場生死搏鬥。

programme.title: 反飆車行動 / Anti Racing Action
programme.desc: 香港警隊與黑勢力誓不兩立，一個以程志飛為隊長的“反飛車組”組成反飆車隊，另一個以蔣小海為首的“飛車黨”是一群黑市非法街頭飆車黨。因為一局地下飆車賽，警方在調查過程中顯露了程與蔣長達十五年的恩怨，更揭開了隱藏在背後的黑勢力組織。

programme.title: 大颱風 / Typhoon
programme.desc: 十年前，身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假，不料突發遇到颱風，張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質，妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭，不料又一場颱風來襲，妻子被颱風所困，女兒又被人綁架。面對這場天災人禍，張不得已在颱風中踏上解救妻女之路。

programme.title: 太空群落 / Invisible Alien
programme.desc: 地球太空基地捕捉到一組來自外太空的神秘訊號，為探尋外星文明，艦長“原”帶領船員駕駛著星際探索飛船“深空號”駛向宇宙，但不久飛船卻神秘失蹤。150年後，深空號突然出現，船上只剩下一名女科學家“尹”。在她的回憶中，飛船在外太空遇到的神秘經歷被逐一揭開。

programme.title: 蛇王島 / King Serpent Island
programme.desc: 利欲熏心的地產商為了開發蛇王島，重金收買以金老四為首的黑市捕蛇團夥，企圖登島滅蛇。與此同時，身為養蛇家族後人的陳崢與動物保護專家週曉曉及馬奮，為了印證泰坦巨蟒存在的傳說，亦到島上搜集資料。陳崢等人為了守護生態和平，與捕蛇團夥在島上展開激烈的救蛇及殺蛇對決。

programme.title: 精武陳真 / Fist of Legend
programme.desc: 為了取長補短，陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間，陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起，為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴，他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演，比武場上陳真展現了中國功夫“深藏不露”的武術內涵。

programme.title: 龍虎制霸 / The Mob
programme.desc: 1928年的上海灘，新生勢力龍德商會為擴大地盤與老牌勢力通明堂產生利益衝突，雙方摩擦不斷。通明堂小少爺週放，因父親被殺要為父報仇，帶領眾人對決龍德商會，卻在復仇過程中與商會二把手林海惺惺相惜。然而二人命定是敵對的，冥冥之中注定有一場激烈的對決。

programme.title: 目中無人 / Eye for an Eye
programme.desc: 盛世大唐氣象萬千，各色人物皆在江湖中行走，身懷絕技的盲眼“捉刀人”成瞎子，遇上慘遭滅門和淩辱的酒家女倪燕。原本不與人有過多交情的成瞎子卻意外與她產生關聯，亦逐漸被捲入一場勢力龐大的暗黑紛爭中。成瞎子開始踏上了尋求公道的復仇之路，而他的真實身份也隨之揭曉。

programme.title: 花木蘭之大漠營救 / Mulan Legend
programme.desc: 北魏年間，新君登基，時局未穩，遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然，大魏公主和親北涼，不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主，要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命，更啟用死囚慕容狄和手下將士組成突襲小隊營救公主，與綿拼死一搏。

programme.title: 大蟲災 / Big Insect Disaster
programme.desc: 一列載著”淘金夢”開往上海的列車突然脫軌墜崖。吳天等一行人倖免於難，卻遭到蜈蚣攻擊。隨後他們逃進了一個怪異村莊，而古怪的村長對這幫各懷鬼胎的倖存者起了殺心。突然成群蜈蚣傾巢而出，在村中大開殺戒。吳天等人該如何逃離險境？古怪的村長到底隱藏著什麼秘密？

programme.title: 鬥士 / Fighter
programme.desc: 少男曾為獲得格鬥冠軍的哥哥少北為驕傲，以為有哥哥在便能永遠保護自己，可以像少年時一樣無憂無慮。最終哥哥在衝刺世界格鬥冠軍擂臺上身受重傷意外身亡。格鬥公司創辦人丹姐訓練少男幫助他復仇，而少男亦替少北贏回遺願，向世界證明黃種人可以屹立於世界。

programme.title: 瘋魔神捻蘇乞兒 / Crazy Beggar SuQiEr
programme.desc: 武狀元蘇燦在打擊販賣大煙的天門教鬥爭中意外受傷失憶，流落街頭淪為"蘇乞兒”，及後被金枝和小果母女收留。小果意外發現了配製好的鴉片膏，被天門教捉走。蘇乞兒為了救小果及避免鴉片禍害百姓，一舉破壞了天門教的陰謀，最終與官府一起剷除天門教。

programme.title: 怪獸獵人 / Monster Hunter
programme.desc: 民國時期上海，怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現，而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時，宇文英雄救美，打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件，在調查過程中，所有線索都指向一個塵封千年的傳說：有一巨獸將會重現人間….

programme.title: 捉妖大仙2 / The Love of Immortal
programme.desc: 天意是天界出名的留級生，因前世孽緣未了無法成仙，後來一次意外他無意釋放了雪女令她越獄下凡，在捉拿雪女過程中，天意發現自己竟是害她淪為雪妖的人。為了彌補過錯，天意自願在陰間路上漂泊千年，一番磨難後，二人終於成婚，但天兵再次下凡捉拿雪女，他們能否如願一起呢?

programme.title: 我是殺手女僕 / I'm a Killer Maid
programme.desc: 漫畫展上，宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女，但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊，但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力及責任，最後二人一起踏上還原人生及對付壞人之路。

programme.title: 蓬萊龍棺之徐福寶藏 / Xu Fu Treasure
programme.desc: 民國年間，日本特務吉岡意圖找到龍棺裡的徐福寶藏，便命人僱傭探險家陳啟龍尋找一本神秘的竹簡。陳在一座古墓中找到竹簡，及後得知是交給日本人，便搶回竹簡和傭金。根據竹簡上的指引，陳與夥伴們踏上蓬萊仙島尋找寶藏之旅，卻不料更神秘驚險的“地獄”正等待著他們。

programme.title: 西行客棧 / Westbound Inn
programme.desc: 抗倭寇志士追馬流落到邊境沙漠之地，選擇在這裡開一家客棧來度過餘生。一天，仇人之女白鹿攜寶箱逃命到客棧，追馬本可有機會把她除掉，然而白鹿要將寶箱中可以對抗倭寇的機密平安送出。追馬為了民族大義，最終放棄仇恨，協助白鹿對抗多方勢力，完成任務。

programme.title: 大話神捕 / Big Talk, God Catcher
programme.desc: 河北省的秋風縣在半個月前寡婦何秀琴在城外被匪徒殺害後，縣城一座名叫赤橋的橋上開始出現「女鬼」。縣太爺陳之章命令捕快郭幻率領眾人限期捉鬼，當郭抓住了裝鬼大漢夏蟲，得知夏裝鬼的理由，才發現原來背後竟藏著一樁離奇的血案！

programme.title: 破神錄 / As God
programme.desc: 在辛亥革命軍閥混戰的民國時期，用幻術蠱惑人心的教派林立，以無量老祖為首的教派常用幻術騙局荼毒百姓。這時大家閨秀孫瑾、人狼鏢師黎叔文、及徵戰沙場多年的功夫奇才楊烈鈞，三人一起誓要揭露所有幻術的真相。但他們及後發現楊與黎各自背後都隱藏著驚天秘密，究竟誰忠誰姦？

programme.title: 奇門遁甲 / Fantasy Magician
programme.desc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥，人族首領黃帝得"奇門遁甲"的力量終於平定世界，之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭週同因為被死對頭追殺，逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了週同，及後在霧隱門的幫助下，週同終於覺醒體內力量，擔起斬妖除魔的責任。

programme.title: 狄仁傑探案 / Detection of Di Renjie
programme.desc: 武則天時期，京城長安接連發生了好幾次離奇死亡案件，因為死因不明，以致忠烈祠飛天壁畫顯靈殺人的謠言愈演愈烈，百姓紛紛認為是天降不祥，人心惶惶。在地方屢破奇案的狄仁傑奉命調查此案，最終不僅破除了謠言，也通過多方排查後讓案情真相大白，找出了真正的兇手。

programme.title: 致命少女姬 / Revenge Girl
programme.desc: 未來世界，人工智慧高速發展，由程非掌控的地下科研組織，為牟取暴利研製激發異能人的晶片。由於一次變故，程下令清除所有實驗者，導致千鶴母親犧牲，而逃出生天的千鶴為替母親報仇，以身涉險對抗惡勢力，在危急關頭激發身體異能，並發現了有關科研組織隱藏十多年的秘密。

programme.title: 奇門暗刃 / Strange Door and Dark Blade
programme.desc: 宋遼太平時期，原本是秘密組織“鳳火軍”培養的特工唐紫煙被安插在京都皇城司任職。正當唐紫煙想悄悄退出，與丈夫過上平靜的餘生時，丈夫卻被鳳凰火軍帶走來威脅唐接受新任務，刺殺來訪的北朝特使皇太弟。唐決心脫離組織，便連同皇太弟攜手打敗鳳火軍，還京城太平。

programme.title: 非常保鏢 / Ultra Protection
programme.desc: 童松因為一場車禍失去雙腿，不過他擁有著超高智商，並與擅長電腦科技的安寧及身手不凡的大牛合夥開辦保鏢公司。公司接到的第一單是保護寵物狗的任務，看似平常，但在委托的過程中實則危機四伏，麻煩不斷，更發現背後暗藏玄機。

programme.title: 巨鱷2 / Mega Crocodile 2
programme.desc: 1925年，平靜的小鎮北海城突然闖入一條巨鱷，不斷有居民被廝殺吞噬。警察隊長鬍彪請了獵戶林七和他的徒弟來抓捕猛獸，林抓住巨鱷後還未鬆口氣卻發現傷人的巨鱷不止一條！在人鱷搏殺，命懸一線之間考驗的不僅是武力，更是人性的善與惡。

programme.title: 青衣道師 / Cyan Wizard
programme.desc: 李道師聽從師傅之命下山歷練，本以為妖邪都是殘忍惡毒，卻在路上經歷了三件事，讓他悟出一些道理。當他看到黑魚精為救她無情的丈夫犧牲自己；一對相愛的戀人為了在一起而放棄生命，共同融入畫中；刺蝟精捨身為報答乾爹養育之恩時，他不禁懷疑到底是人還是妖更加可怕？

programme.title: 真假濟公 / Ji Gong
programme.desc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻，感應到白水鎮村民有難，於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓，差點把濟公燒死，但最終黃元被濟公所感化，並幫助濟公一起降魔伏妖。

programme.title: 封神演義之斬仙飛刀 / Zhan Xian Fei Dao
programme.desc: 亂世末期，商朝遭到週武王的進攻，被週軍將領楊戩打得節節敗退。軍師申公豹向紂王建議招攬梅山七怪助商攻週，因為七怪之首袁洪與楊戩一樣精通八九玄功可七十二變。紂王命申公豹立刻前往梅山將七怪納入麾下。於是，楊戩率領的週軍與袁洪率領的商軍之間的戰鬥正式拉開帷幕!

programme.title: 故事販賣機 / Story Machine
programme.desc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成，包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事；《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會，卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事；《官能許願》超能力男孩，以器官為代價，拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事；及《雞湯泡麵》在城中售賣吃了能讓人開心的雞湯泡麵的奇幻故事。

programme.title: 了不起的高二八班 / Seventeen and a Half Years Old
programme.desc: 張君佳是一名高中學生，為了接近校花黃巧姍，他想拍一部微電影，讓黃巧姍主演。藝術節快要到來，他決定組織同學們拍一部校園喪屍片，拍攝期間，眾人幾經波折，劇組更瀕臨於崩潰邊沿。然而友情、親情和愛情交織成的共同經歷，讓大家重新定義了青春，收穫了友情與成長！

programme.title: 屠魔：王者徵途 / The Sword
programme.desc: 上古時期，因人類的貪念欲望所生成的魔王阿爾薩召集亡靈軍團徵服了世界，而上古人類領袖以鮮血鑄成聖劍封印了阿爾薩。千百年後，阿爾薩破開封印，開始在東原大陸發起進攻。此時聖殿騎士團聯合東方巡夜山宮等武林門派踏上尋找聖劍之路，以求再次封印阿爾薩，拯救人類。

programme.title: 食人鯊 / Shark Evil
programme.desc: 一群偷獵者在公海上對鯊魚進行殘酷的捕殺，激怒了大白鯊。偷獵者死於鯊魚的口中，之後盛怒的大白鯊把注意力轉向了在附近遊艇上慶祝畢業的四個好友。於是，四人與大白鯊之間展開了一場激烈的生死搏鬥。

programme.title: 唐伯虎之偷天換日 / The Story of Tang BoHu
programme.desc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金，卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人，不料那人正是皇上，因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕，唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中，卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造反證據隱藏在《牧牛圖》中，決心要揭開秘密，識破馮的陰謀。

programme.title: Zhong Kui Exorcism
programme.desc: After demons massacre his hometown and kill his loved ones, young Zhong Kui sets out for revenge. Along the way, he meets a half-demon princess and uncovers a sinister plot behind his former lover's mysterious resurrection. Wielding the Sacred Demon-Slaying Sword, he battles evil and becomes the legendary Demon Queller Zhong Kui.

programme.desc: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

programme.title: The Ones You Didn't Burn
programme.desc: After their father's death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their father's death which now threatens them both.

programme.title: Chapter 1 Mae Nak Reborn
programme.desc: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklace's dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: 3AM - The Driver
programme.desc: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

programme.title: The Windmill Massacre
programme.desc: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. programme.title: Malee

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2
programme.desc: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents' dark history. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.desc: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. programme.desc: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

programme.desc: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Room For Rent
programme.desc: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: 3 Demons

programme.title: Endless Love

programme.title: Mulu Nakru
programme.desc: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.desc: As a boy, Xie Yi Zhong performed a spirit-summoning ritual and accidentally invoked Bai Wu Chang, the White Reaper, triggering a tragedy. programme.title: Model Family

programme.title: Chapter 1 Mae Nak Reborn
programme.desc: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklace's dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: 3AM - The Driver
programme.desc: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

programme.title: The Windmill Massacre
programme.desc: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. programme.title: Malee
programme.desc: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancer's headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2
programme.desc: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents' dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. programme.title: Mid-night Two

While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Tear Us Apart
programme.desc: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

programme.desc: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. programme.desc: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. programme.title: 3 Demons
programme.desc: Deputy Sheriff James is assigned to guard the body of a woman used in a mysterious ritual. After accidentally completing the unfinished ceremony, he unleashes three dark demons. As psychological torment, terrifying hallucinations and real demonic forces close in, his sanity slowly unravels, plunging him into an inescapable abyss of darkness.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Mulu Nakru
programme.desc: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: The Spore
programme.desc: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.desc: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. programme.title: Chop Chop
programme.desc: A young couple's tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: 3AM - The Campsite
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them. When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

programme.title: Sinister - The Gates of Hell
programme.desc: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hell's Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi.
